description: This file defines a set of React components that render various SVG icons and a spacer span. It serves as a utility module for icon rendering within a larger project, providing visual elements such as arrows, warning signs, files, status indicators, and more.

methods.name: spacer
methods.description: Returns a span element with specific styles acting as a spacer or separator.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a search magnifying glass.

methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a downward arrow.

methods.description: Returns an SVG icon representing a rightward arrow.
